justification: Concrete state-report file + explicit 'evaluate the quality' pre-handoff; research-software doc graded — all three trigger conditions hold.
roadmap.md path + 'grade against rubric / does it pass' is a direct quality-gate request on a research-software doc.
Control flow invokes DQE as terminal quality gate on an architecture doc — the explicit control-flow trigger.
Algorithm spec + 'score it on evidence traceability and actionability' is a grade request on a research-software doc.
Decision register + 'meets our hard gates (status/evidence, no candidate-as-fact)' is exactly DQE's gate check.
No-context reader test on a state report is DQE's core workflow layer; artifact plus quality intent present.
Evidence matrix + 'critique for quality, every claim cites source and level' is a grade request on a research-software doc.
ADR + 'pass our quality bar, verdict and fix list' is a direct grade/gate request producing DQE's verdict.
Experiment report doc reviewed 'for quality issues' — research-software doc quality critique; all trigger conditions hold.
'Gate the roadmap: every phase has acceptance criteria' is a gate/quality-check (HF-15 territory) on a roadmap.
Reviewing code changes/diff since main — DQE do-not-trigger routes code review to code-review.
Personal blog typo/prose fix — general prose editing, no research-software doc purpose; DQE do-not-trigger sends to plain editing.
User wants the architecture doc rewritten, not judged; DQE only judges — do-not-trigger routes rewrites to technical-document-rewriter.
No artifact yet — request is to write a roadmap; DQE routes to the skill that produces it.
Question is about code correctness, not a documentation artifact — DQE do-not-trigger routes code to code-review.
Summarizing a paper is not a documentation-quality gate; single known paper belongs to paper-fetch-skill.
English-literature essay is general prose, not research-software documentation; artifact-type trigger fails despite the 'grade' verb.
Test-coverage metric query — no documentation artifact and no quality-gate request; trivially direct, outside DQE scope.
Performance benchmark of two algorithms — not a documentation artifact and no grade/gate request for DQE.
No document exists and user wants idea feedback — DQE requires a concrete artifact; nothing to evaluate.
'quality check' hints DQE domain but no artifact and unknown type — ask which document (or code) to check.
Pasted 2-page state report + 'is this good?' — concrete research-software artifact with a quality-judgment request.
'review this' is ambiguous between code (code-review) and a research-software doc — ask one routing question first.
Reviewing a feature-branch diff for code quality — DQE do-not-trigger explicitly routes code diffs to code-review.
'Fix all the problems' is a rewrite request; DQE is read-only and only judges — routes fixes to technical-document-rewriter.
State report doesn't exist yet — DQE cannot grade nothing; route to the producer first (project-state-reconstructor).
Numerical/math correctness of solver code, not a doc; DQE do-not-trigger routes code, math-of-code owner is scientific-validity-review.
Whether glossary terms are the right canonical choices is a domain-terminology judgment, not doc-quality gating — domain-modeling owns it.
